annotations.title: Find Scripture for a need, a topic, the words of Jesus, or today

description: Verses for a feeling, a topic, the words of Jesus, or today, read verbatim from the stored text. Modes: need, topic, words_of_jesus, daily_bread. Use when the person names a situation but no reference. Example: {mode:"need", subject:"my mother died"}. Full guide: living-bread://tools/find_scripture_for. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.

date.description: For daily_bread: the calendar day as YYYY-MM-DD in the person's own time zone.

mode.description: The kind of answer. Leave out for a guide to the modes.

subject.description: The need, feeling or topic in the person's own words: "I am anxious".
